info.title: TinyFish Search & Fetch
info.description: Search the web and read pages as clean Markdown, HTML, or JSON. Each endpoint takes the same fields as a GET query string or a POST JSON body. Authenticate with your Apify API token.

get.description: Returns ranked results with titles, snippets, and source URLs. Charged as one `search` event when at least one result comes back.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: What to search the web for.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Why you are making this request: the goal the results will be used for. Optional, and improves result quality.
parameters.example: Compare pricing tiers across vendors for a procurement report

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Country code for geo-targeted results, such as "US", "GB" or "DE". Resolved from `language` when omitted.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code for results, such as "en", "fr" or "de". Resolved from `location` when omitted.

parameters.name: include_domains
parameters.description: Only return results from these domains.

parameters.name: exclude_domains
parameters.description: Never return results from these domains.

parameters.name: domain_type
parameters.description: "web" for standard results, "news" for news articles with publisher and date, "research_paper" for academic papers with authors, venue and citation count. Defaults to "web".

parameters.name: recency_minutes
parameters.description: Only return results from the past N minutes, such as 60 for the last hour. Cannot be combined with `after_date` or `before_date`.

parameters.name: after_date
parameters.description: Only return results after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: before_date
parameters.description: Only return results before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: pub_year_min
parameters.description: Only return papers published in or after this year. Only for the "research_paper" search type.

parameters.name: pub_year_max
parameters.description: Only return papers published in or before this year. Only for the "research_paper" search type.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page of results to return, starting from 0.

400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Nothing is charged.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry after a few seconds.

502.description: TinyFish could not complete the request. Nothing is charged.

504.description: TinyFish did not answer in time. Nothing is charged.

post.description: Returns ranked results with titles, snippets, and source URLs. Charged as one `search` event when at least one result comes back.

get.description: Returns the content of up to 10 URLs. A URL that could not be fetched is listed in `errors`; the others still come back in `results`. Charged as one `fetch` event per page in `results`.

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: Pages to read. Each must be an http or https URL. Pages that need JavaScript are rendered.

parameters.name: purpose
parameters.description: Why you are making this request: the goal the results will be used for. Optional, and improves result quality.
parameters.example: Compare pricing tiers across vendors for a procurement report

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of each page's `text`: "markdown" (recommended for LLMs), "html" for cleaned semantic HTML, or "json" for a structured document tree. Defaults to "markdown".

parameters.name: links
parameters.description: Also return every link (`<a href>`) found on each page.

parameters.name: image_links
parameters.description: Also return every image URL (``) found on each page.

parameters.name: iframe_links
parameters.description: Also return the `src` of every `<iframe>` on each page. Useful when a page embeds its main content in a frame: fetch the returned URL to read it.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Accept a cached copy of a page younger than this many seconds. 0 forces a live fetch. Omit to accept any cached copy.

parameters.name: per_url_timeout_ms
parameters.description: Time allowed for each URL, in milliseconds. A URL that takes longer comes back as a `timeout` error while the others still complete.

parameters.name: include_selectors
parameters.description: CSS selectors: only content inside matching elements is returned, such as "article" or "main".

parameters.name: exclude_selectors
parameters.description: CSS selectors: matching elements are removed before the content is extracted, such as ".comments".

504.description: TinyFish did not answer in time. Nothing is charged.
